title: Wine and Cheese Pairing: How to Choose a Wine for Any Cheese Board
hub_title: Wine and Cheese Pairing: How to Choose a Wine for Any Cheese Board
description: Learn how to pair wine and cheese by matching salt, creaminess, texture, intensity and maturity with wine acidity, sweetness, tannin and body. Includes practical pairings for fresh, soft, washed-rind, hard, aged and blue cheeses.
